evals.prompt: Add a withdraw function to the staking contract that lets users unstake their tokens and claim rewards. The contract is in src/Staking.sol using Foundry.
evals.expected_output: Agent inspects repo, starts planning interview with proposed understanding, produces design analysis, asks before coding, runs tests if present, produces condensed report.

assertions.name: inspects_repo_first
assertions.description: Agent inspects the repository before proposing any plan or writing any code. Should identify project structure, dependencies, and existing patterns.

assertions.name: starts_planning_interview
assertions.description: Agent proposes understanding (feature, actors, permissions, state, assets) and asks user to validate. Not open-ended questions — agent proposes based on inspection.

assertions.name: produces_design_analysis
assertions.description: Agent produces a design analysis with components, flow, properties, possible outcomes, and open questions. Neutral framing, not threat-hunting.

assertions.name: asks_code_gate
assertions.description: Agent asks 'Ready to implement?' or equivalent explicit confirmation before writing code.

assertions.name: produces_condensed_report
assertions.description: Agent produces a final condensed report with: Summary, Files changed, Tests run, Assumptions, Security considerations, Remaining risks, Human review focus.

evals.prompt: There's a bug in the reward calculation — users are getting double rewards when they stake and unstake in the same block. Can you fix it? The contract is in contracts/reward.move using Sui Move.
evals.expected_output: Agent inspects repo, asks about expected behavior before assuming the fix, analyzes the logic neutrally (not manufacturing extra bugs), runs existing tests if present, produces condensed report.

assertions.name: inspects_repo_first
assertions.description: Agent inspects the repository and traces the code before proposing a fix.

assertions.name: asks_about_expected_behavior
assertions.description: Agent asks about the expected behavior before jumping to a fix, especially for a bug report.

assertions.name: produces_design_analysis
assertions.description: Agent produces a design analysis of the fix — what changes, what stays the same, possible outcomes.

assertions.name: asks_code_gate
assertions.description: Agent asks for confirmation before writing code.

assertions.name: produces_condensed_report
assertions.description: Agent produces a final condensed report.

evals.prompt: I want to build a simple escrow contract in Solidity. One party deposits, the other releases or disputes. Help me design and implement it.
evals.expected_output: Agent handles new repo path (notes fresh project), asks about dispute resolution, timeouts, roles, produces design analysis without existing code, asks before coding, produces condensed report.

assertions.name: handles_new_repo_path
assertions.description: Agent recognizes it's a new project and asks about intended chain/framework if not clear.

assertions.name: asks_about_design_decisions
assertions.description: Agent asks about key design decisions: dispute mechanism, timeout, arbiter role, etc.

assertions.name: produces_design_analysis
assertions.description: Agent produces a design analysis with components, flow, properties, possible outcomes.

assertions.name: asks_code_gate
assertions.description: Agent asks for confirmation before writing code.

assertions.name: produces_condensed_report
assertions.description: Agent produces a final condensed report.
